intro.heading: 🌟 Introduction to PM Mudra Loan 🌟
intro.content: The PM Mudra Loan is a government-backed scheme that provides financial assistance to small businesses and entrepreneurs in India 🇮🇳. The scheme was launched in 2015 by the Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi, with the aim of promoting entrepreneurship and job creation 🌱. The loan is available for various purposes, including starting a new business, expanding an existing one, or financing working capital requirements 💸. In this article, we will guide you through the process of applying for a PM Mudra Loan online in 2026 📆.

sections.heading: 📝 Eligibility Criteria for PM Mudra Loan 📝
sections.content: To be eligible for a PM Mudra Loan, you must meet the following criteria: ✅ you must be an Indian citizen, ✅ you must be between 18 and 65 years old, ✅ you must have a valid business plan, and ✅ you must have a good credit score 📈. The loan is available for various types of businesses, including manufacturing, trading, and services 🏭. The maximum loan amount that can be borrowed is ₹10 lakhs, and the interest rate varies depending on the lender and the loan amount 🤑.

sections.heading: 📁 Required Documents for PM Mudra Loan 📁
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan, you will need to submit the following documents: ✅ identity proof (Aadhaar card, PAN card, etc.), ✅ address proof (passport, driving license, etc.), ✅ business registration documents (sole proprietorship declaration, partnership deed, etc.), ✅ income tax returns, and ✅ bank statements 📊. You may also need to provide additional documents, such as a business plan, balance sheet, and profit and loss statement, depending on the lender and the loan amount 📈.

sections.heading: 📊 Step-by-Step Guide to Apply for PM Mudra Loan Online 📊
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan online, follow these steps: 📈 step 1: visit the official website of the lender or the PM Mudra Loan portal, 📈 step 2: fill out the online application form with your personal and business details, 📈 step 3: upload the required documents, 📈 step 4: submit the application form, and 📈 step 5: wait for the lender to process your application and sanction the loan 🏦. You can also apply for the loan through a mobile app or by visiting a branch of the lender 📱.

sections.heading: 🌟 Benefits of PM Mudra Loan 🌟
sections.content: The PM Mudra Loan offers several benefits to small businesses and entrepreneurs, including: ✅ low interest rates, ✅ flexible repayment terms, ✅ minimal documentation, and ✅ quick processing 🕒. The loan can be used for various purposes, including working capital, equipment purchase, and business expansion 📈. The scheme also provides an opportunity for entrepreneurs to develop their business skills and knowledge through training and mentorship programs 📚.

faqs.q: What is the interest rate for PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The interest rate for PM Mudra Loan varies depending on the lender and the loan amount. However, the interest rate is generally lower than other types of loans, ranging from 8.5% to 12.5% per annum 📈.

faqs.q: What is the maximum loan amount that can be borrowed under PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The maximum loan amount that can be borrowed under PM Mudra Loan is ₹10 lakhs 🤑.

faqs.q: What are the repayment terms for PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The repayment terms for PM Mudra Loan vary depending on the lender and the loan amount. However, the loan can be repaid over a period of 5 to 7 years, with a moratorium period of up to 6 months 📆.
